children: Tata Consultancy Services Limited (NSE:TCS) posted Q2 FY27 revenue ₹73,188cr and net profit ₹13,884cr with a 24.0% operating margin as it booked $9.6B TCV, ~ $3.1B AI run‑rate and MHP acquisition plans, even as a PERM suspension and rising costs threaten margin targets.
Previous Week Recap
TCS Q2 Revenue, Profit, Dividend
: TCS Q2 FY27: consolidated revenue ₹73,188 crore, net profit ₹13,884 crore, operating margin 24.0%, AI revenue run-rate ~$3.1B, TCV $9.6B, workforce ~598,056, interim dividend ₹12.
TCS Wins TCV, Porsche Deal, MHP Acquisition, Best Buy AI Center
: TCS won $9.6B in TCV this quarter, struck a five‑year deal with Porsche, agreed to acquire MHP for about €320M (~$1.45B, pending approvals), and will convert Best Buy’s India GCC to an AI center.
US PERM Halt, ~40k Staff, 15k Hire Plan

: U.S. Department of Labor suspended TCS from PERM, halting new and pending green‑card filings. TCS reports single‑digit PERM filings recently, ~40,000 U.S. staff, plans to hire 15,000 over five years.
Margins Under Pressure From Porsche MHP

: TCS reported quarterly operating margin near 24%. Management warned growth, rising subcontractor costs, deal ramp-ups and the Porsche MHP acquisition will pressure margins, complicating a 25% target.
AI Revenue ~$3.1B, Headcount 598,056
: TCS reported about $3.1B in annualized AI revenue, cited productivity gains from AI and transformation investments, and added 4,258 employees, taking total headcount to 598,056.
Quarterly TCV $9.6B, Momentum
: TCS reported quarterly total contract value of $9.6B, up from $9.5B. Deal growth driven by energy, utilities, technology services and manufacturing, signaling steady deal momentum.
Operating Cash Flow Rs.14,190 Cr
: TCS generated Rs.14,190 crore in operating cash flow, equal to over 102% of net income, indicating strong cash conversion from core operations for the reported period.
Second Interim Dividend Declared FY27
: Tata Consultancy Services declared a second interim dividend for FY27 after a Rs 12 per share interim in July 2026; board may review another interim with Q2 results; firm paid large FY26 payouts.
Revenue Mix: NA Dominant, UK Growth, India Decline
: TCS revenue mix: North America 48.3% (+1.5% YoY), UK 17.8% (+4.5% YoY), Europe 3.3%, India ~6% YoY growth but −10.3% sequential decline.
Honeywell SAP S/4HANA Partner rollout
: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) named global SAP S/4HANA partner for Honeywell, deploying TCS Crystallus and Rise with SAP to standardize processes, modernize apps and enable AI-driven automation.
